description: This file contains constant definitions, macro definitions, and function prototype declarations for the 'subframePreProc' function used in AMR speech codec preprocessing, including licensing and standard compliance information.

methods.name: subframePreProc
methods.description: Performs spectral pre-processing on a speech segment for AMR codec, with inputs including mode and spectral factors, and outputs including filter coefficients, residuals, impulse response, and target vectors.
